Provide `chatInput` (and optionally `sessionId`) as run inputs; the original started from a chat message.
The original started from an inbound webhook (POST /website-chat-example). Run it with `cdecli workflow run <slug> --ver <version> -d '{"body": {...}}'` or through the workflow API.

"Encrypt email" (code.crypto): uses crypto.createCipheriv, crypto.randomBytes, crypto.scryptSync (encryption / random bytes), which the Transform runtime does not provide; the step stops the run when it gets there.

"WooCommerce - Get User": the original used Store (WooCommerce original); check the mapped shopify/SHOPIFY_GET_ALL_CUSTOMERS params before running.
"AI Agent" kept conversation memory (memoryBufferWindow); sessionId is set to the run-input sessionId.
"AI Agent" used agent tools in the original: WooCommerce_Tool (toolWorkflow). The cdecli agent calls connectors directly; connect credentials for the services those tools reached.
"WooCommerce Get Orders" authenticated with wooCommerceApi in the original; add the matching Authorization header (or use the service's connector).
"DHL": the original used DHL; check the mapped dhl/DHL_GET_SHIPMENTS params before running.
"Merge Tracking Data" merged two branches; NodeSync waits for both inputs and exposes them as data1/data2 (the original merge mode was append).

"Merge Order and Tracking Data" merged two branches; NodeSync waits for both inputs and exposes them as data1/data2 (the original merge mode was combine).
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
Connect dhl: `cdecli credential create -n "dhl" -p dhl --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).
Connect shopify: `cdecli credential create -n "shopify" -p shopify --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).

notes:
## Find WooCommerce User-ID
User-ID is required to query past orders

## Add DHL tracking information
Queries the status of shipped orders from DHL.

Can be skipped if order tracking should not be available or replaced with other services like UPS.

# Setup
## Generally
- The environment variable `NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN` has to equal or include the value `crypto` (FYI: is default on n8n cloud) as it is required to run this workflow


## To test the workflow
1. Set a valid email address of a user that exists in WooCommerce in the Mock Node "Mock Data"
2. Enable the node "Mock Data"
3. Disable the node "Decrypt email address"
4. Use the built-in chat by pressing the "Chat" button


## For production use:
1. Update the "System Message" in the node "AI Agent" for specific use case. At least the name of the shop should be changed
2. Integrate the chat into the website. An example can be found in the box "Example Website Implementation"
3. Disable or delete the node "Mock Data"
4. Enable the node "Decrypt email address"
5. Enable Workflow

## Example Website Implementation
Example Code for a website can be found in node "Respond to Webhook".

More information about the embeddable chat can be found [here](https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/tree/master/packages/%40n8n/chat#installation).

Required changes:
- Change "webhookUrl" to the displayed in "Chat Trigger" node
- Set the encrypted email address dynamically. The value has to be calculated in the backend to make it truly secure
- Use a unique password for email en-/decryption and use it in the backend and this workflow (can be set in node "Decrypt email address")


The example page can be opened by calling the production Webhook-URL of the node "Webhook Example Page". It only works if the "For production use" steps on the left have been followed.
